description: This file contains utility functions for resolving and detecting the tool protocol used in conversation histories, specifically handling deprecated XML protocol and current native protocol, with functions to determine protocol based on conversation content.

methods.name: resolveToolProtocol
methods.description: Determines the effective tool protocol based on locked protocol, default to native, ignoring deprecated XML protocol.

methods.name: detectToolProtocolFromHistory
methods.description: Analyzes conversation history to detect whether the last tool use was via native or XML protocol based on presence of 'id' in tool_use blocks.
